server.note: Pinned OpenDAoC fork (Offline DAoC 0.35 lineage: server synced to upstream v0.35 d337d18, 0.35 world and navmeshes); macOS port overlay in server/ is applied on top. The ref is verified by git, and the port patches are pre-checked with git apply --check before building.

client.note: Hashes pinned from the release's download-manifest.json; game.dll hash is the pristine v0.35b Sluaghbinder client.

wine.note: athei/wine-build cx-26.3.0-8: CrossOver 26.3 Wine (x86_64, Rosetta 2) with i386 support, the bundled x87sidecar (Rosetta x87 JIT, cooperative attach) and mtld3d (D3D9 on Metal). x87sidecar is what lifts the client from ~7 to 60+ FPS: the game thread is otherwise CPU-bound in Rosetta's x87 emulation.

graphics.note: Optional graphical patches the user turns on one by one (retina, srgb, textures, anisotropy). Only daoc graphics pulls it: the first call clones this commit into upstream/graphics/, and every call refuses to run unless HEAD is this commit and git status shows no local changes; daoc client install never fetches it.
